mapper.select: /*+ INDEX(d IDX_COST_ALLOCATION_DETAIL_ALLOCATION_ID) INDEX(tc IDX_COST_CENTER_ID) */ SELECT /*+ CARDINALITY(d 100) */ d.DETAIL_ID as detailId, d.ALLOCATION_ID as allocationId, d.TARGET_CENTER_ID as targetCenterId, tc.CENTER_NAME as targetCenterName, d.ALLOCATION_BASIS_VALUE as allocationBasisValue, d.ALLOCATION_RATIO as allocationRatio, d.ALLOCATED_AMOUNT as allocatedAmount, d.REMARK as remark, d.CREATE_TIME as createTime, d.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, ROUND(d.ALLOCATION_RATIO * 100, 2) || '%' as allocationRatioPercent FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION_DETAIL d LEFT JOIN T_COST_CENTER tc ON d.TARGET_CENTER_ID = tc.CENTER_ID AND tc.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE d.ALLOCATION_ID = #{allocationId} AND d.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY d.CREATE_TIME OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

/*+ MATERIALIZE */ WITH monthly_data AS ( SELECT SUBSTR(ALLOCATION_PERIOD, 1, 6) as month, ALLOCATION_METHOD, COUNT(1) as allocationCount, SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) as totalAmount FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND ALLOCATION_PERIOD >= #{startPeriod} AND ALLOCATION_PERIOD <= #{endPeriod} GROUP BY SUBSTR(ALLOCATION_PERIOD, 1, 6), ALLOCATION_METHOD ) SELECT month, allocationMethod, allocationCount, totalAmount, ROUND(totalAmount / allocationCount, 2) as avgAmount, FIRST_VALUE(allocationCount) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY totalAmount DESC) as maxMethodCount FROM monthly_data ORDER BY month, totalAmount DESC

/*+ MATERIALIZE */ WITH method_stats AS ( SELECT ALLOCATION_METHOD, COUNT(1) as totalCount, SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) as totalAmount, AVG(TOTAL_AMOUNT) as avgAmount, STDDEV(TOTAL_AMOUNT) as stddevAmount FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND ALLOCATION_PERIOD >= #{startPeriod} AND ALLOCATION_PERIOD <= #{endPeriod} GROUP BY ALLOCATION_METHOD ), method_targets AS ( SELECT a.ALLOCATION_METHOD, COUNT(DISTINCT d.TARGET_CENTER_ID) as uniqueTargetCount, AVG(d.ALLOCATION_RATIO) as avgRatio FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION a JOIN T_COST_ALLOCATION_DETAIL d ON a.ALLOCATION_ID = d.ALLOCATION_ID WHERE a.IS_DELETED = 0 AND d.IS_DELETED = 0 AND a.ALLOCATION_PERIOD >= #{startPeriod} AND a.ALLOCATION_PERIOD <= #{endPeriod} GROUP BY a.ALLOCATION_METHOD ) SELECT s.ALLOCATION_METHOD as method, s.totalCount, s.totalAmount, s.avgAmount, s.stddevAmount, t.uniqueTargetCount, t.avgRatio, ROUND(s.totalAmount * 100.0 / SUM(s.totalAmount) OVER(), 2) as percentage, CASE WHEN s.stddevAmount / s.avgAmount > 0.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN s.stddevAmount / s.avgAmount > 0.2 THEN 'MEDIUM_VARIANCE' ELSE 'LOW_VARIANCE' END as varianceLevel FROM method_stats s LEFT JOIN method_targets t ON s.ALLOCATION_METHOD = t.ALLOCATION_METHOD ORDER BY s.totalAmount DESC

/*+ MATERIALIZE */ WITH period_trend AS ( SELECT ALLOCATION_PERIOD, COUNT(1) as allocationCount, SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) as totalAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT SOURCE_CENTER_ID) as sourceCenterCount, AVG(TOTAL_AMOUNT) as avgAmountPerAllocation FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND ALLOCATION_PERIOD >= #{startPeriod} AND ALLOCATION_PERIOD <= #{endPeriod} GROUP BY ALLOCATION_PERIOD ) SELECT ALLOCATION_PERIOD as period, allocationCount, totalAmount, sourceCenterCount, avgAmountPerAllocation, LAG(allocationCount) OVER (ORDER BY ALLOCATION_PERIOD) as prevCount, LAG(totalAmount) OVER (ORDER BY ALLOCATION_PERIOD) as prevAmount, ROUND( (allocationCount - LAG(allocationCount) OVER (ORDER BY ALLOCATION_PERIOD)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(allocationCount) OVER (ORDER BY ALLOCATION_PERIOD), 0), 2 ) as countGrowthRate, ROUND( (totalAmount - LAG(totalAmount) OVER (ORDER BY ALLOCATION_PERIOD)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(totalAmount) OVER (ORDER BY ALLOCATION_PERIOD), 0), 2 ) as amountGrowthRate FROM period_trend ORDER BY ALLOCATION_PERIOD
